titre: Applying for a middle school or high school grant
resume: Automatic assessment at enrollment or an application before October 15: income limits, amounts, the tax notice to provide and the rules when parents are separated or have shared residence.
aQuoiCaSert: The bourse de collège (middle school grant) and the bourse de lycée (high school grant) help low-income families pay school costs. They are paid every term. For the 2026-2027 school year, what counts is the reference tax income (revenu fiscal de référence) on the 2026 tax notice for 2025 income. Most of the time you apply by ticking the box agreeing to automatic assessment when you enroll your child. This entry also recaps the steps for enrolling in middle school (collège) and high school (lycée).
quiEstConcerne: Families of a middle or high school student attending a public school, a state-contracted private school (privé sous contrat) or the Cned (national distance-learning center) in a full class.
Parents of a child in CM2 (last year of primary school) moving up to 6e (first year of collège), or in 3e moving up to high school.
Separated parents: only one parent can apply.
aSavoir: Middle school grant 2026-2027: €40, €112 or €175 per term depending on income. 2025 income limits: €18,488 for 1 dependent child, €22,754 for 2, €27,020 for 3, €31,286 for 4, €35,553 for 5.
High school grant 2026-2027: 6 levels (échelons), from €168 to €357 per term. Example for 1 dependent child: limit of €22,037 for level 1. The official simulator tells you your level.
Married or civil-partnership (PACS) couple: one joint tax notice. Unmarried couple living together: each partner's tax notice. Single parent living alone: only your tax notice.
Shared residence (middle school grant): the parents choose which of them applies. If both submit an application, both are rejected. A waiver signed by the other parent is not accepted.

Agreeing to automatic assessment at enrollment in a public school counts as an application for the child's whole time in middle and high school. Without this agreement, you must apply again every year, even if the child had a grant the year before.

Paid in 3 installments, around the end of December, end of March and end of June. For a child who eats at the canteen (demi-pensionnaire) or boards (interne), canteen or boarding fees are deducted first.
Repeated unjustified absences of more than 15 days can reduce the grant. In high school, a merit grant (bourse au mérite) may be added for a distinction (mention) in the brevet exam.

etapes.titre: Estimate your entitlement with the simulator
etapes.detail: Have your 2026 tax notice and the number of dependent children at hand. The simulator can be reached from the service-public.gouv.fr pages.

etapes.titre: At enrollment, tick the box agreeing to automatic assessment
etapes.detail: Online with EduConnect or on the paper file, in public schools. It's the simplest way: there is nothing else to do.

etapes.titre: Otherwise, apply between September 1 and October 15
etapes.detail: Online on Scolarité services with EduConnect, or on a paper form at the school office.

Full 2026 tax notice (both for unmarried couples), RIB, completed and signed form, proxy in private schools, residence judgment if you are separated. With shared residence, agree with the other parent on who applies.

etapes.titre: Submit the file to the school office before the deadline
etapes.detail: Ask for a receipt or note the date you submitted it.
If refused in middle school, you can appeal within 2 months. In high school, you have 15 full days (jours francs) after the notice to appeal to the rectorat.
